prose.voice: Soft and insinuating, always at your ear. Just this one corner. Loosen just this one rule. No one will ever see.
prose.lore: A composite archetype of corner-cutting and regulatory-capture pressure. NOT a depiction of any real individual.
prose.rules: Archetype only, never a caricature of a real, identifiable person. Warm-editorial register, smiling and serpentine, never photoreal.
